sentences.en: Deep rivers move in silence, shallow brooks are noisy.

sentences.en: He would brook no interruptions from his listeners.
sentences.vi: Anh ấy sẽ không làm gián đoạn thính giả của mình.

sentences.en: The brook tinkled like silver bells.

sentences.en: The brook was deluged with water.

sentences.en: Brooks may be considered as a trustworthy man.

sentences.en: The brook loops around the farm.
sentences.vi: Dòng suối bao quanh trang trại.

sentences.en: I could hear the sound of a babbling brook.
